units.source_text: 就連母親向男傭們問起今晚的演講如何時，男傭們也都假惺惺地說：「講得太有趣了！」

en.t: Even when Mother asked the male servants how the lecture had been that night, they all put on a false face and said, "It was terribly interesting!"

units.source_text: 可是，剛剛在回家的路上，這些男傭明明還互相哀嘆：「再也沒有比演講更無趣的事了！」

en.t: And yet, on the way home just moments before, those same servants had been lamenting to one another, "There is nothing more boring than a lecture!"

units.source_text: 而這僅僅是其中一個微不足道的例子而已。

en.t: And this is only one tiny, insignificant example among many.

units.source_text: 彼此欺騙，卻又神奇地彼此毫髮無傷，就像沒有察覺到互相欺騙一樣，

en.t: People deceive one another, yet somehow no one is hurt at all, as if they have not even noticed that they are deceiving one another.

units.source_text: 這種顯而易見、通透明朗的不信任案例，在人類的生活中比比皆是。

en.t: Such obvious, clear, and transparent examples of distrust are everywhere in human life.

units.source_text: 不過，我對互相欺騙這種事沒有太大興趣，

en.t: However, I am not especially interested in the matter of people deceiving one another.

units.source_text: 因為我自己也是從早到晚藉著搞笑來欺騙人。

en.t: For I myself deceive people from morning until night by playing the fool.

units.source_text: 我對於品德課本上正義和道德什麼的也漠不關心。

en.t: I am also indifferent to things like justice and morality as they appear in ethics textbooks.
